about: Skábma - Snowfall is a never before seen representation of indigenous Sámi stories and culture. Explore Nordic beauty in a world where the old northern campfire tales come alive!
Use your wits to solve environmental puzzles and platforming challenges in this narrative 3rd person adventure.

The daily life of a Sámi village is disturbed after an accident at a nearby Tar-Burning Pit. An odd disease starts spreading across the area, affecting everything from the land to the people and animals.
You play as Áilu, a young Sámi herder searching for a runaway reindeer doe. The mystery of the growing disorder starts to unravel when Áilu finds an old enchanted drum, Goavddis.
Time is running out for the infected, but the long lost knowledge of Sámi healers, Noaidis, is still beating within the drum.
summary: Harness the powers of the Noaidi Drum to fight against a spreading disorder!
